verdict: ГОРИЗОНТ ПЕРЕОЦЕНКИ НЕ СПАСАЕТ: базис платится независимо от частоты — -1.9%/год при ежедневной переоценке, -2.2%/год при раз в 30 дней.
question: is the basis bill a cost of carry, or a cost of CLOSING too often?
interpretation: the basis bill is independent of horizon: carry with basis is unprofitable regardless
limitations: Only funding-ranked coins are tested here; the selection control (p3b-selection-control) showed all selections lose on a daily mark.
Deferring basis realisation changes the return series, not the economic exposure — a daily mark is the conservative reading.
Funding is recorded on payment days and accrued daily, which overstates funding on days with no payment.
